question_text: What is the additive inverse of -15?
step_by_step_solution: The additive inverse of an integer 'a' is '-a', satisfying a + (-a) = 0. Inverse of -15 is +15 because (-15) + (+15) = 0.
Subtracting a negative quantity is equivalent to adding its positive opposite: 0 - (-A) = 0 + A = A.
Apply subtraction rule a - (-b) = a + b: (-8) - (-13) = -8 + 13 = +5.

Historical Timeline: Alexander the Great was born in 356 BCE and died in 323 BCE. (a) How old was Alexander when he died? (b) How many years after 680 BCE was the year 360 BCE?
step_by_step_solution: (a) Age = Birth Year - Death Year = 356 - 323 = 33 years old. (b) Years elapsed = 680 - 360 = 320 years.
